title: view: the call
description: Asks for the caller's own view of the Accord: for each crossing its own terms select, whether it crosses, is asked or is blocked, and each question it answers. A proposed Accord serves it, and so does a founded one; only a member is shown one, and only its own.

call.description: What is signed: the call's canonical bytes.

accord.description: The Accord id the caller expects the window to serve.

at.description: The caller's clock; the door refuses a call more than 60 seconds from its own (stale).
